actions.reason: The Verifier describes a coherent, estimable biological phenotype for K2_C0001: coordinated down-regulation of related signaling and proliferative programs in RNA, mirrored by a consistent mutation pattern (VHL and PBRM1 depletion, BAP1 enrichment), with the structural report showing comparable internal cohesion and a feasible internal resolution. The stated limitations (set-versus-rest contrast, partial driver-panel coverage, post-hoc annotation, geometric rather than biological evidence) are acknowledged but do not preclude retaining this discovery-stage candidate for downstream validation.

The Verifier describes a coherent, estimable biological phenotype for K2_C0002 that mirrors K2_C0001: coordinated up-regulation of the same related signaling and proliferative programs in RNA, with a consistent mutation pattern (VHL and PBRM1 enrichment, BAP1 absence), and comparable internal cohesion in the structural report. The stated limitations (relative set-versus-rest contrast, partial driver-panel coverage, post-hoc annotation, geometric rather than biological evidence) are acknowledged but do not preclude retaining this discovery-stage candidate for downstream validation.
